rationale: Registered before evaluating circuit-engine MemoryPanels integration. The existing memory_panel_v1 bus and Newton limits remain unchanged. Hardware pot values/taper and the parameter-to-position coordinate are declared inferences, never fitted to a patch or voltage target.

programmer_integration.source_fixture: Every compiled source equivalent loaded by its documented receiver conductance reproduces the already solved bus operating point; no resistor is counted twice.
programmer_integration.diagonal_impedance_fixture: All analog rows of both ranks and each programmer selector, bank fractions0.2/0.5/0.8; diagonal incremental bus impedance compared with central +/-10nA current injection into the independent full network, retaining all inactive diodes and shared rail. programmer_integration.legacy_fixture: Changing electrical programmer positions while Legacy is selected cannot change rendered samples; frames without electrical positions and Engine::setParams retain the existing physical-unit API. Existing compatibility captures remain mandatory.
programmer_integration.invalid_transaction_fixture: Nonfinite or out-of-domain positions reject the complete source-policy frame before publishing parameters, selectors, compiled sources or audio state.
programmer_integration.audio_fixture: In circuit and Pure policies, selected programmer switches and independent cutoff/level changes measurably affect rendered audio; the other unselected programmer cannot affect a factory tab. This is a routing assertion, not a tone or hardware measurement. Existing phrase/headroom metrics remain reported without widened tolerances.
